brief: Inspect Halloway Hill 138/13kV (SUB-SGW-490) prior to the heat event, noting that its ONAN cooling system type requires no forced cooling de-rating adjustments under MG-021. Because the supplied documents do not cover the specific prioritisation threshold for a criticality 5 asset or a 32-year age, crews must apply the ambient and sustained event loading restrictions outlined in MG-021 and MG-025. Record every de-rating applied, the reason, the value, and the period in accordance with MG-021.
